title: Zéro French
tagline: A free, project-based curriculum that takes you from zero French to passing the TCF Canada.

paths.title: A1 Basics
paths.description: Start from zero: learn the French alphabet, pronunciation, greetings, basic grammar and everyday vocabulary.

sections.title: Foundations & Pronunciation
sections.description: Master the French alphabet, accents, vowel mechanics, nasal sounds, and core phonetic rules.

lessons.title: The Alphabet, Accents, and Spelling
lessons.description: Learn the 26 French letters, avoid English letter traps (G/J, E/I/U), master the 5 accents, and dictate Canadian postal codes and emails.

lessons.title: Pure Vowels, U vs OU, and Nasal Sounds
lessons.description: Master French monophthongs, the tricky U (/y/) versus OU (/u/) distinction, and the three core nasal vowels (an, on, in).

lessons.title: Silent Letters, Elision, and Liaisons
lessons.description: Learn the CaReFuL final consonant rule, elision with apostrophes, mandatory vs forbidden liaisons, and phonetic shifts (s/x to /z/, d to /t/).

lessons.title: Numbers, Time, and the Calendar
lessons.description: Master cardinal numbers 0 to 100+, the vigesimal system (70–99), telling time in 12h/24h systems, days, months, and Canadian date conventions.

sections.title: Greetings & Introductions
sections.description: Say hello, introduce yourself, and understand basic polite phrases in French.

lessons.title: Greetings and Politeness
lessons.description: Learn to greet people formally and informally, say goodbye, and use basic polite expressions.

lessons.title: Personal Identity and Essential Verbs
lessons.description: State your name, nationality, age, and profession using the essential verbs être and avoir.

lessons.title: Family and Relationships
lessons.description: Describe immediate family members, marital status, and express relationships using possessive adjectives.

lessons.title: Everyday Objects and Grammatical Gender
lessons.description: Name common home and workplace objects, master definite and indefinite articles (le, la, un, une), and describe items with basic colors.

lessons.title: Project: Introduce Yourself
lessons.description: Record a short self-introduction in French using the greetings and polite phrases you have learned.

sections.title: Daily Routine & Places
sections.description: Conjugate regular verbs, talk about your daily schedule, and navigate buildings and town landmarks.

lessons.title: Regular -er Verbs and Daily Actions
lessons.description: Conjugate present tense regular -er verbs for routine morning and evening activities, work, and leisure.

lessons.title: The Essential Irregular Triad: Aller, Faire, Venir
lessons.description: Master the high-frequency verbs aller, faire, and venir to describe movement, activities, weather expressions, and immediate future/past actions.

lessons.title: Asking Questions and Essential Interrogatives
lessons.description: Formulate questions in French using intonation, est-ce que, and the core interrogatives (qui, que, où, quand, comment, pourquoi, combien).

lessons.title: Places in Town and Navigation Prepositions
lessons.description: Identify municipal landmarks, master spatial prepositions with contractions (à côté de, en face de, près de), and give directions.

lessons.title: Project: Daily Routine & Neighborhood
lessons.description: Write a 60–120 word email to a friend describing your daily schedule, living area, and extending an invitation under timed TCF-SO conditions.
